download_charging_sites.title: Download charging location database
download_charging_sites.description:
Select the country whose charging locations should be downloaded directly from OpenStreetMap. The existing database is backed up automatically before activation.

**Note:** After the download, the charging locations are processed and optimized locally. Depending on database size and hardware, this step may take several minutes. During this time, the progress bar may temporarily remain unchanged.

download_charging_sites_success.title: Charging location database activated successfully
download_charging_sites_success.description:
The charging location database for **{country} ({country_code})** was successfully downloaded from OpenStreetMap, processed and activated immediately.

**Download and processing**
- OSM elements: **{downloaded_elements}**
- Normalized charging stations: **{normalized_stations}**
- Detected charging locations: **{searchable_sites}**
- Geohash cells: **{index_cells}**
- Skipped elements: **{skipped_elements}**

**Database**
- Size: **{database_size}**
- Total duration: **{duration}**

The new database is immediately available for charging location detection.

route_tracker_settings.title: Route Tracker
route_tracker_settings.description: Enable separate route recording and select the position source. This setting does not replace the existing Ford Triplog vehicle tracker.

data_description.route_tracker_enabled: Records GPS points during a trip using a separate position source.
data_description.route_source_type: Select the integration from which Route Tracker receives its GPS coordinates.

osrm_settings.title: OSRM route smoothing
osrm_settings.description:
Ford Triplog can optionally match recorded GPS routes to the OpenStreetMap road network using an external local OSRM service. Without an enabled OSRM connection, the existing raw route remains fully available.

When saving, the connection is tested. A matching radius of 15 meters is used by default.

data_description.osrm_enabled: Enables optional local route smoothing via OSRM.
data_description.osrm_match_radius: Search radius per GPS point. Recommended and default: 15 m.

osrm_connection_result.title: OSRM connection saved

data_description.storage_read_backend: Select which backend is used for reading stored Ford Triplog data. JSON is the default. SQLite is currently intended for Phase 2 validation.

vehicle_sensors.title: Vehicle sensors
vehicle_sensors.description: Select the Home Assistant entities Ford Triplog should use as vehicle data sources. Required fields must be configured; optional sensors may be left empty.

data_description.ignition: Sensor providing the ignition or driving state.
data_description.odometer: Sensor providing the current odometer value.
data_description.tracker: Device tracker providing the vehicle latitude and longitude.
data_description.soc: Optional sensor providing the current state of charge in percent.
data_description.charging: Optional sensor providing the current charging status.
data_description.last_charge: Optional sensor containing data from the most recently completed charging session.
